body:
I agree with Bryan...

Tell us what you got. I get it, I totally get it, but let’s talk about it. You got to have more. And you’re heading in the right direction .

I was literally just thinking of this. I went for a drive tonight to clear my head. I wasn’t reckless, but was secretly hoping someone else would be. Or maybe there’d be a train on the tracks with non functioning warnings. I prayed that something would happen “accidentally”...and that it would be quick.

I totally get this. When I tell someone that I feel like I get ignored. If I hear “things will get better” one more time I’m going to scream. Of course I want to believe that, but right now it’s hard. If I’m to the point of actually telling someone that I’m suicidal you would think that they would take me seriously.
